query: SELECT symbol,date,open,high,low,close,volume,raw_close,raw_high,raw_low FROM read_parquet('D:/TSP/data/kline_daily_enriched/date=*/*.parquet',hive_partitioning=true) WHERE date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-01' AND DATE '2026-10-23' AND symbol IN ('002687.SZ','002241.SZ','002945.SZ') ORDER BY symbol,date
limitations: Nearest and selected anchors externally supplied
